faits.fait: Since January 2023, Oxantis SA has brought together Groupe VYV’s optical, hearing and dental third-party payment (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly) management. Before that, two centers within the group shared it: Equasanté and UHMs.
Oxantis manages this third-party payment for Groupe VYV’s supplementary health insurers (mutuelles) (Harmonie Mutuelle, MGEN, MNT), for those of VYV Partenariat and for insurers outside the group.
The third-party payment managed by Oxantis is called “complex”: the insurer must give prior approval for the reimbursement provided by the policy.
The oxantis.net portal is a white-label interface supplied by Viamédis, a partner of Groupe VYV.
According to Groupe VYV, Oxantis solutions are available to all optical centers.
In 2022, Oxantis processed 2,245,392 optical invoices and paid more than €1.2 billion directly to health professionals, across all sectors.
Since February 1, 2022, MGEN, MGEN Efficience Santé and MAEE members can get third-party payment at any optician. Before that, only opticians in the Kalixia network could offer it through Oxantis.

Since July 1, 2025, for members who moved to MGEN Accolade, you must choose “MGEN Accolade” and not “MGEN” on the portal. Pending quotes for these members were deleted on June 30, 2025 and had to be entered again.
For an MGEN customer, ask for the third-party payment card: it shows which payer to choose on the Oxantis portal.
Each store logs in to oxantis.net with its email address and password. A code is then sent at every login, by phone call or text message.
The Oxantis portal works like the Viamedis one: the same coverage request, tracking and billing screens, on a different domain.

conventionnement: Contact the Oxantis contracting department: 0 821 21 00 07 (premium-rate number) or tp-oxantis-convention@oxantis.fr.
Once the account is open, log in on oxantis.net with your email address and password, then the code received by phone call or text message.
